text: Part two. The zombies are marching. *Together*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay sneaks Bit into the science tent.

speaker: narrator
text: Doctor Ada hasn't slept in *three weeks*.

speaker: scientist
text: A screen? In my tent? Are you *insane*?

speaker: bit
text: Highly advanced assistant. I come in *peace*.

speaker: hero
text: Why are they marching? They used to just *wander*.

speaker: scientist
text: Because nature *already invented* zombies.

speaker: scientist
text: In the rainforest, a fungus infects *ants*.

speaker: scientist
text: The ant leaves its nest. Then it *climbs*.

speaker: scientist
text: It bites a leaf vein and *never lets go*.

speaker: bit
text: Usually about twenty six centimeters *above the ground*.

speaker: scientist
text: One study found they bite at *noon*.

speaker: hero
text: And then? Please say *and then nothing*.

speaker: scientist
text: Then a stalk grows from its head. *Spores*.

speaker: hero
text: That's the most disgusting thing I've ever *heard*.

speaker: scientist
text: Someone copied it. The update makes people *climb*.

speaker: friend
text: Climb *what*? There are no trees downtown.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit pulls up the map. The city's tallest *building*.

speaker: bit
text: Gray Tower. The biggest phone antenna *in the country*.

speaker: scientist
text: When they reach the top, the tower *broadcasts*.
